title: runstate v0.2 envelope
description: The substrate record: one entry in a per-run append-only topic log. Structural only -- the substrate routes/indexes on the envelope and never interprets `body`, and does not constrain which topics may appear (so the log can be backed by NATS JetStream / Kafka / Redis Streams). Topic *semantics* and well-known body shapes are pinned by the separately-versioned convention schemas (subscription / lifecycle / launcher / value).

seq.description: The substrate clock: a per-log monotonic total order assigned on append.

topic.description: The protocol-owned routing key (closed vocabulary at the convention layer); opaque non-empty string at the substrate layer.

name.description: Open, application-owned identifier (e.g. a metric name, or a subscription target). Null when unused; never the empty string.

request_id.description: Correlates a response to its request and scopes visibility. Null for broadcasts (visible to every reader); never the empty string.

body.description: Opaque to the substrate. Well-known shapes are pinned per-topic by the convention schemas; user `value` payloads are arbitrary.
